messages.content_text:
4H looked bullish / 1H looked like it was retracing already
Initially waited for a deeper 4H retracement but market open started ripping towards my DOL creating a weak 1H CISD.
Waited for a 5min retracement into 1H CISD + 5 min FVG + 0.62 FIB + 18:00 ko + midnight ko
Started going to DOL again without a good entry but created a 5min/1min RB at 10am ko in same zone with other confluences.
Entered on RB with SL below it and TP at Asia high
